chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn Maymūn narrated from al-Ṣādiq, from his father, peace be upon them both, who said:
"A woman in ihram must not wear a face veil, because the ihram of a woman is in her face, and the ihram of a man is in his head."

key_terms.إِحْرَامَ: the consecrated state entered for hajj or ʿumrah
key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: the man, in contrast to the woman in this ruling
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman, in the context of legal rulings of ihram
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمَةُ: a woman who is in the state of ihram
key_terms.تَتَنَقَّبُ: wears a face veil covering the face
key_terms.رَأْسِهِ: his head, the locus mentioned for the man’s ihram ruling
key_terms.وَجْهِهَا: her face, the locus mentioned for the woman’s ihram ruling

ai.seo_question: Can a woman wear a face veil while in ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning clothing in the state of ihram. It explains that a muhrimah does not wear a face veil, distinguishing the woman’s ihram in relation to the face and the man’s ihram in relation to the head.
